.addLineLayer

Source: R/utilities-molecule-plots.R
dot-addLineLayer.Rd

Add line layer of a molecule plot

Usage

.addLineLayer(plotObject, type, value, position)

Arguments

plotObject

A ggplot object

type

one of "horizontal", "vertical" or "diagonal" Note that for "diagonal", geom_abline is used. value of intercept is taken as is for linear scale but corresponds to the log of value for log scale. For instance, intercept = c(-1, 0, 1) with log scale actually means that the line will go through c(0.1, 1, 10) because c(-1, 0, 1) = log10(c(0.1, 1, 10)).

value

value of xintercept or yintercept

position

line position for aesthetic properties

Value

A ggplot object
